page.overview:
Who is Finn's Grandson?

Finn's Grandson exists in Pillow World, as seen in "Puhoy". He is a hybrid who is 25% Human and 75% Pillow Person.

He appears at the foot of Finn's deathbed. He has a head of blonde hair, much like his grandfather, implying that he is the child of either Jay or Bonnie, Finn's Pillow World children.
